description: I’m thrilled to announce my candidacy for the Minnesota House in District 24A. Rooted in our community’s values of hard work, kindness, and helping our neighbors, I’m ready to bring common-sense solutions to St. Paul — and I’m asking you to join me on this journey.

title: I’m Running to Represent District 24A — Let’s Get to Work — Heather Holmes for MN House 24A
